prompts.title: Summarize selection
prompts.body:
Summarize the following in 5 bullet points:

{{selection}}

prompts.title: Explain simply
prompts.body:
Explain this simply, with one concrete example:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.title: Code review
prompts.body:
Review this code for bugs, security issues and readability. Be specific and concise:

{{code}}

prompts.title: Compare options
prompts.body: Compare {{option_a}} and {{option_b}} for {{use_case}}. Use a table, then give a recommendation and say what would change it.

prompts.title: Research a company
prompts.body: Give me a sourced profile of {{company}}: what they do, funding, leadership, main competitors and recent news.

prompts.title: Fact-check a claim
prompts.body:
Fact-check this claim. Cite sources and say what is right, wrong or uncertain:

{{claim}}

prompts.title: Translate and explain
prompts.body:
Translate to {{language}} and explain any idioms or tricky words:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Debug an error
Literature scan
prompts.body: Find the most cited and most recent papers on {{topic}}. For each: authors, year, one-line finding, and a link.

prompts.title: Meeting briefing
prompts.body: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with {{person_or_company}} about {{topic}}: background, recent news, likely questions, and points to raise.

prompts.title: From beginner to expert
prompts.body: Teach me {{topic}} in three levels: beginner, intermediate and expert. Finish with the 5 most common mistakes.

prompts.title: Pros and cons
prompts.body: Give an honest list of pros and cons of {{decision}}, then say what information would change your conclusion.
